About this item

【2000W Dual Motor】The H20 Pro e-bikes for adults feature two brushless motors with a combined output of 2000W, reaching a top speed of 28+++ mph in just 0-3 seconds. With the Shimano 7-speed gear system, conquering steep inclines is effortless, allowing confident exploration. Choose between single or dual motor modes for your ride.
【Long Range 48V 23AH Battery】Equipped with UL-certified 48V 23AH batteries and a BMS system, the H20 Pro electric bike for adults offers up to 70 miles of pedal-assisted travel per charge, enabling you to go anywhere you desire.
【Fat Tires & Dual Hydraulic Disc Brakes】Featuring puncture-resistant 20"x 4" fat tires, this e-bike provides excellent grip on various terrains, including snow, beaches, and rough mountain roads. The dual hydraulic disc brakes ensure powerful and precise braking, even in wet conditions, ensuring your safety.
【Shimano 7-Speed & F/R Shock Absorber】With a high-strength lockable and adjustable front suspension and rear suspension fork, our foldable electric bike effectively absorbs shocks and enhances ride control. The Shimano 7-speed shifting system offers reliable precision and comfortable ride control.

【Compact & Convenient Design】Crafted from high-quality 6061 aluminum alloy, the frame of the bike is sturdy and durable. It features a collapsible upright tube for easy storage and comes with a colorful multi-function LCD, high-brightness front light, and turn signal light. The bike is 90% pre-assembled, ensuring quick setup.

Product Description

Summer is here, and it's the perfect time to get out and explore the great outdoors!

40-60 miles in pure electric mode, 50-70miles in pedal assist mode

Dual Hydraulic Disc Brakes

Lockable and adjustable enhanced front suspension for smoother navigation on rough terrains.
Superior rear hydraulic shock absorber for improved performance.
Hydraulic dual brakes reduce braking distance by 50%, ensuring a safer ride in wet conditions.

Bright Headlights & Brake Lights&Turn Signals

Our electric bike features waterproof headlights, brake lights, and turn signals that are perfect for safe night riding.
You can ride with confidence and have clear visibility whether you're commuting after work or exploring new routes in the dark.

Colorful Smart LCD Display

Our electric bicycle features a dynamic multi-color LCD display, adding excitement to your rides.
Stay visually engaged as you monitor essential information such as speed, distance, battery level, and more with vivid, easily readable colors.

How to start up the ebikes for adults?

1.Confirm the battery is fully charged.
2.Use the key to turn on the battery switch by twisting it (counterclockwise to turn it on, and clockwise to turn it off).
3.Use the key to turn on the switch located next to the right handlebar (by twisting it clockwise to turn it on, and counterclockwise to turn it off).
4.Press and hold the "M" button located next to the left handlebar to complete the start.
5.Twist the throttle to start riding
